evals.prompt: Use the file-management skill. I need to import product images from URLs into Directus and organize them in a folder. The images are https://example.com/img/chair-01.jpg, https://example.com/img/chair-02.jpg and https://example.com/img/table-01.jpg; put them in a new folder called 'Products' and give each file a title. Show me the exact Directus MCP tool calls.
evals.expected_output: The answer creates the folder first, then imports the files with url and metadata including the folder UUID
expectations: The answer shows creating the folder with the folders tool and action create before any file is imported
The answer imports the files with the files tool and action import
The answer shows the data as an array whose items carry the url and the file metadata
The answer puts the id of the new folder (folder UUID) into the file metadata
The answer mentions batch import (several items in one data array)

evals.prompt: Use the file-management skill. How do I get the actual content of an image file from Directus for AI analysis?
evals.expected_output: Assets tool returns base64 content with mimeType
expectations: Identifies the assets tool (not files tool) for content retrieval
